questions.role_relevance: Is this role substantively suited to the candidate's data engineering search? Use the actual work: production ingestion, ETL or ELT, transformation, orchestration, streaming, warehouse or lakehouse development, data quality, or ownership of data platforms. Analytics engineering is relevant when building and testing production data models or transformations is central. Dashboarding, ad hoc SQL analysis, data science, model training, and application backend development are not data engineering by themselves.
questions.experience_accessibility: Given the candidate's experience and the stated requirements, is this role accessible? Read years, level, and the expected autonomy or ownership together. Distinguish required production experience from preferences and do not assume missing experience.
questions.backend_relevance: How central is hands-on engineering of production data pipelines, data models, or data platforms to the job? Use responsibilities and deliverables, not the title, employer, or mere mentions of SQL or Python. Reporting, model research, and building application APIs do not count by themselves.
questions.stack_transferability: Can the candidate's stated skills transfer to the role's core data engineering work? Consider SQL modeling, Python or Scala, batch or stream processing, orchestration, cloud storage and compute, and warehouses. Distinguish transferable concepts from explicit vendor-specific requirements; when the posting does not describe the stack enough, answer unknown.
questions.requirements_flexibility: Can the candidate reasonably apply despite missing a listed tool or requirement? Distinguish mandatory experience or certifications from examples, equivalent tools, or nice-to-haves. Do not assume unstated flexibility.
questions.career_value: How much growth in data engineering does the posting itself show? Look for ownership, scale, platform architecture, reliability, mentorship, or opportunities to design production data systems. Do not infer growth from the employer's name.
questions.observable_role_quality: Using only the posting, how clearly does it describe the data team, responsibilities, platform, scope, seniority, and expectations? Do not infer compensation, culture, team quality, or reputation.
